name: keyring
tagline: Accounts, profiles and credentials: the vault the rest of the family authenticates against.
description: One person logs in once. Their profiles hold the credentials for third-party services, and any service that needs one asks keyring for a usable credential at the moment it needs it: a refreshed OAuth token, an API key, or the fields for a login form. No other service stores a secret, and no endpoint ever hands a stored secret back out.
highlights: OAuth consent flows and token refresh on behalf of a person
Internal credential resolution for services acting for a person
